intro: Gemini Assistant is good at phone jobs: call Mom, set a timer, play music, answer a quick question. Nobody disputes that. The confusion starts when people expect it to do work jobs. It cannot read your inbox, brief you for a meeting, or keep a project moving across Slack, Notion, and email. GAIA lives in that gap. It manages the workday across 50+ tools while your phone assistant keeps handling the phone.
